title: No Enchantment Glints
description: Remove the purple glint in your enchanted tools and armour.
body: ![No enchantment glints](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a950a1056b10df3d8194174b4c9cc7a23c89e65f.png)No Enchantment GLlints is a resourcepack dedicated to remove the purple glint on your enchanted tools or armour. It can be used for pvp, better performance, casuals or anyone that wants to have a clean tool or armour look
